ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var setName = if (vars.user.name != null) "name = :name" else "" var setEmail = if (vars.user.email != null) "email = :email" else "" var setDateOfBirth = if (vars.user.dateOfBirth != null) "date_of_birth = :dateOfBirth" else "" var setSex = if (vars.user.biologicalSex != null) "biological_sex = :biologicalSex::biological_sex_enum" else "" var setHeight = if (vars.user.heightCm != null) "height_cm = :heightCm" else "" var setWeight = if (vars.user.weightKg != null) "weight_kg = :weightKg" else "" var setActivityBaseline = if (vars.user.activityBaseline != null) "activity_baseline = :activityBaseline::activity_baseline_enum" else "" var setCaloricTarget = if (vars.needsRecalculation) "daily_caloric_target = :caloricTarget" else "" var setClauses = [setName, setEmail, setDateOfBirth, setSex, setHeight, setWeight, setActivityBaseline, setCaloricTarget] filter ($ != "") joinBy ", " --- "UPDATE users SET " ++ setClauses ++ ", updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = :userId AND deleted_at IS NULL"
